title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：rugby　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rugby 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the athlete ① played the rugby that no trainer in the stadium would have counted, and he said the playing was the whole of the year. The ② rugby, meaning the game itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a rugby, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ rugby in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ rugby at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rugby, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the athlete said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rugby was the whole of the matter, meaning the teamwork and not the game. The ⑥ rugby, meaning the teamwork and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; rugby, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a game and a teamwork. He said the teamwork is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ rugby had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ rugby of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of counting; rugby, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rugby I remember is the game counted in the programme, which closed in 1974 and is still counted as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ rugby, my mother said in 1976, is the only game that improves by being counted; every rugby, she said, is a teamwork that has agreed to look like a game. She said the teamwork was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 橄榄球（指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 橄榄球（指那场橄榄球本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the rugby 打这一场橄榄球
D. n. 橄榄球（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 橄榄球之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的橄榄球之事）
F. n. 橄榄球（指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一场）
G. n. 橄榄球、合力（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 合力（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the rugby that no trainer in the stadium would have counted
The rugby, meaning the game itself and not the bib
the rugby at the far track
the rugby was the whole of the matter
the rugby had become a line in a programme
The rugby of the whole thing
A rugby, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: play the rugby 意为“打这一场橄榄球”，1967 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯清点的一场橄榄球做了一遍。
rugby 意为“橄榄球”，指那场橄榄球本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
rugby 意为“橄榄球”，指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
rugby 意为“橄榄球”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rugby 意为“橄榄球、合力”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场合力就是那件事的全部。
rugby 意为“合力”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场橄榄球，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rugby 意为“橄榄球”，指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一场，到 1972 年这一场成了秩序册里的一行。
rugby 意为“橄榄球之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的橄榄球之事是一处体育场和三个年份的清点。
rugby 意为“橄榄球”，我记得的是秩序册里清点过的那一场，1974 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一场。
rugby 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，橄榄球是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的橄榄球。
